message.content: {"verdict": "conflict", "citations": ["rbi-13641"], "evidence": [{"doc_id": "rbi-13641", "quote": "The bank shall constitute a Committee of the Board to be known as 'Special Committee of the Board for Monitoring and Follow-up of cases of Frauds' (SCBMF) with a minimum of three members of the Board, consisting of a whole-time director and a minimum of two independent directors / non-executive directors. The Committee shall be headed by one of the independent directors / non-executive directors."}], "confidence": 1.0, "rationale": "The RBI directions require the Special Committee of the Board (SCBMF) to have a minimum of three board members consisting of a whole-time director and at least two independent or non-executive directors, and to be headed by an independent or non-executive director, whereas the clause sets a different composition and has the Managing Director chair it."}
